address: 8F, One Chinachem Central, 22 Des Voeux Road Central, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: The smart minimalist dining room dotted in Italian furniture provides the perfect foil for elegant Italian classics, whose flawless craftsmanship showcases the head chef’s Sicilian roots and premium produce. To experience his culinary vision in all its glory, go for the 6- or 8-course tasting menu that changes regularly to reflect the seasons. The house-made pasta, like red prawn linguine, is simply unmissable!...
